title: Browse and audition extracted instrument banks
changes: Browse stored bank, program and key-map references and audition supported PCM, fixed-rate PCM, CGB square and CGB wave tones independently of a song.
Share CGB mute with the sequence player, link to source waveforms, preserve selector focus and show progress through the actual one-shot or selected preview duration.
validation: Synthetic units rom-data-viewer-instruments-synthetic-xc9e3zo9 and rom-data-viewer-instruments-oneshot-94ohotzu checked source resolution, playback, key maps, mute, focus and short PCM progress in Linux Chrome.

Protected local-page unit rom-data-viewer-instruments-oneshot-local-q7k0c8uu checked all four stored voice kinds and a one-shot sample using real Web Audio; Docker unit rom-data-viewer-instruments-docker-w3mo8nxs matched Python on synthetic input.
limitations: Audition timing, pitch, envelope and mixing are approximate; unsupported or missing tones are not played. Physical audio and Windows remain unverified, and the shared target volume was unavailable.
